scope_note: The out-of-state, Schedule VI and classification group, repaired after the V7 round and re-sealed. The repair teaches the two delivery paragraphs of M.G.L. c. 94C, s. 18(d1/2), the relationship between the statute's at-least-every-24-hours prescription-monitoring submission and the regulation's end-of-next-business-day, and that every Schedule VI drug is a Massachusetts controlled substance with no federal counterpart. MA-Q-0009 was removed from SG-CONTROLLED-SCHEDULES as unanswerable within its declared scope, and is now mapped to no section. A later editor answered the scope-gate signals: it added the electronic-prescribing mandate that the Schedule VI exception excepts, and the treatment of a disqualified Failover, to SG-MA-SCHEDULE-VI, and declined the rest. Declined: seven federal rules against SG-MA-SCHEDULE-VI, because they govern federally scheduled substances and a Schedule VI drug is one no federal schedule lists; four schedule-keyed Massachusetts rules, for the schedules they name; MA-SCHEDULE-VI-VALIDITY against SG-MA-OUTSTATE-PRESCRIPTIONS, whose windows are pathway-specific; and against SG-CONTROLLED-SCHEDULES the refill and monitoring-mechanics rules, since that section teaches the schedule as a premise rather than as an answer to what may be refilled, transferred or reported.

prior_audit_reference.note: V7C rated the superseded SG-MA-OUTSTATE-PRESCRIPTIONS and SG-MA-SCHEDULE-VI hashes MINOR_EDIT and CLAUDE-FRESH-B4-SG-V7L rated the superseded SG-CONTROLLED-SCHEDULES hash MINOR_EDIT. Both drove this repair, bind none of the hashes frozen here, and are excluded from the auditor package.
